I've asked June in a DM to approve drafting the mail with the rate. The approval request is logged as pending. Once she says yes, I'll save the draft with subject "Tansley 2027 rate" and tell you. You'll still send it yourself. If you'd rather go to Anselm, I can ask him instead.
